# X Bookmarks

> Donovin's saved X (Twitter) bookmarks, one Markdown file per bookmark. 718 bookmarks. Exported 2026-11-09T09:46:16-06:00.

Post text is exactly as shown on X: original line breaks, t.co links expanded, hidden media and quote links removed.

## Files

- [index.md](https://donovinsims.github.io/x-bookmarks/index.md): table of every bookmark (date, author, posts in thread, title, link to its file)
- [bookmarks.jsonl](https://donovinsims.github.io/x-bookmarks/bookmarks.jsonl): one JSON object per line. Best for bulk reading. Keys: url, username, posted_at, metrics, title, text (bookmarked post), thread ({id, url, text, bookmarked, quoted_url, media}[], empty if not a thread), full_text (whole thread joined with "n/N" headers, or the post text), quoted ({url, author, text} or null), media ({type, url}[]), file, md_url.
- md/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<handle>-<id>.md: one file per bookmark (filenames are stable; date is the post date in America/Chicago)

## Markdown file schema

YAML frontmatter, values JSON-encoded, only these keys:
- url (string), username (string, author handle), posted_at (string, YYYY-MM-DD, America/Chicago)
- metrics (object: likes, reposts, replies, quotes, bookmarks, views; integers, a key is omitted only if X does not report it)

Body, in this order: "# <title or first line>", "## Post" (exact text of the bookmarked post), then only when present "## Thread" (every post of the author's self-reply thread in order, each as "### n/N" with its URL, text, quoted link and media; the bookmarked one is marked), "## Quoted post" (blockquote), "## Media" (list of type: url).
Threads are the author's consecutive self-replies starting at the thread's first post.
UTF-8, LF line endings, no HTML.
